metadata.method_name: harmonic-coordinate screen of four rival mechanisms of Benford deviation
metadata.description: Fits five rival size laws to the country-population panel, converts each into its exact leading-digit law by periodizing the log-density, and scores four candidate mechanisms against the shared c_1 instrument, each against its own matched parametric-bootstrap null.

headline_answer.question: How closely does Benford's law fit the leading digits of country populations?

conventional_answer_exact_benford_baseli.reading: on the conventional reading the panel is in Nigrini's 'acceptable conformity' band (MAD = 0.00919) and the naive chi-square does reject exact Benford (chi2 = 83.2 on 8 df, p = 1.1e-14). That p-value assumes independent rows and is reported here only because the field expects it.

why_the_conventional_answer_is_not_trust.reading: the nominal 8,732 country-years are 246 effectively independent observations: a country's mantissa barely moves across its 37 even years, so the design effect is 35.5 and any i.i.d. p-value is meaningless. In harmonic coordinates the observed |c1| = 0.0749 sits 1.33x the entity-cluster Rayleigh floor of 0.0565, i.e. BELOW the 2-sigma detection threshold of 0.0901.

the_fitted_law_cannot_explain_it.reading: the BIC-selected law predicts |c1| = 3.547e-02 against an observed 0.0749, within the amplitude-ratio window; the mechanism is not excluded by amplitude.

headline_answer.answer: The panel's first-digit MAD is 0.00919 (acceptable conformity), and the conventional exact-Benford chi-square rejects at the naive i.i.d. reading. But the nominal 8,732 rows correspond to only 246 effectively independent observations (design effect 35.5), and the observed harmonic amplitude |c1| = 0.0749 is inside the 2-sigma entity-cluster envelope, so the panel is consistent with exact Benford once the entity dependence is honoured. The BIC-selected size law's own prediction is 0.0355 against the observed 0.0749 (ratio 2.11), inside the amplitude-ratio window, so the static-mixture mechanism is not excluded by amplitude alone -- but its matched-null p and its adequacy score are in the verdict above. Verdict: Candidates A, D clear at least one level but none clears all pre-registered levels; the result is deferred rather than a survivor.

constants.question: How closely does Benford's law fit the leading digits of country populations?

cross_section_A.level: X (one row per entity: circular-mean mantissa across even years)
cross_section_A.reading: the mixture mechanism predicts a cross-sectional |c1| at the pooled fit's own value; the entity cross-section is where that prediction is sharpest, because pooling country-years averages away the between-country spread the mechanism is about

verdict.survivor_rule: c survives iff p_c < 0.05 at level P AND p_c < 0.05 in both S1 and S2 AND q_c >= 0.05 where defined AND c has the smallest p_c among those meeting the above
verdict.verdict: Candidates A, D clear at least one level but none clears all pre-registered levels; the result is deferred rather than a survivor.

power_statement.statement: Every naive i.i.d. p-value on this panel is to be ignored. Clustering inflates the variance by deff = 35.5 (rho = 0.957, 37.0 years per entity), so the effective sample size is 246 rather than 8732. The Rayleigh noise floor is E|c1| = 0.0565, the 2-sigma detection threshold is 0.0901, and the 80%-power minimum detectable amplitude is 0.1280.

dropped_entities.entity: Less developed regions, excluding least developed countries

A.note: target fraction below 0.05 is 0.03-0.08; above 0.15 means the null is miscalibrated and must be replaced by the nonparametric entity bootstrap

B.note: target fraction below 0.05 is 0.03-0.08; above 0.15 means the null is miscalibrated and must be replaced by the nonparametric entity bootstrap

C.note: target fraction below 0.05 is 0.03-0.08; above 0.15 means the null is miscalibrated and must be replaced by the nonparametric entity bootstrap

V1.note: the calibration calls the SAME scoring functions as the real screen, with real entity structure and year labels, so a miscalibrated null shows up here rather than as a false winner later

V3.note: md_amp_80pct_power is NaN/inf when no injected amplitude in the tested grid reached 80% power and no admissible log-linear extrapolation could be made; the power curve is then read as 'underpowered at every amplitude tested', not as a finite threshold
